name: fabric
description: Multi-provider agent fabric — any agent (Claude / Codex / …) invoking, orchestrating, and handing off to models of any provider. One `call` primitive (task/review/agent/image modes) + fan_out + a minimal observe proxy that dissolves the Foundry-vs-tap conflict.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-provider agent fabric — any agent (Claude / Codex / …) invoking,
interface.longDescription: Multi-provider agent fabric — any agent (claude / codex / …) invoking, orchestrating, and handing off to models of any provider. One `call` primitive (task/review/agent/image modes), parallel fan_out, and a minimal observe proxy that dissolves the Foundry-vs-tap conflict.
defaultPrompt: Use the Fabric plugin to invoke, orchestrate, and hand off to models of any provider (deepseek / claude / codex).
Tools: call (one-shot; mode task/review/agent/image-*; codex supports write:true + cwd), fan_out (parallel calls),
Pass observe:true to call to capture the child API traffic into runDir/http.jsonl.
